plan: Owner decision 2026-10-28: the paid-RPC provider is recorded in .planning/STATE.md, not in the environment, and a missing or unreadable record fails closed. Record format: exactly one line paid_rpc_provider: none means no provider recorded (SAFE-4 and SAFE-8 BLIND advisory, amendment 2026-10-25 section 2.4). Any other state is recorded (strict, BLIND stays KILL): file missing or unreadable, no key line, two or more key lines, empty value, any other value. The image carries .planning/STATE.md and nothing else from .planning.
